name: Comfortfoods Co-packing & Processing
old_description: For over 30 years our goal has been to provide our customers with high quality, delicious tasting, healthy ingredients and custom blends. Whether you bring us your formulation, we develop a custom proprietary formulation just for you or you use one of our fantastic house recipes, we can blend, package, label it in a variety of bags, bottles, or pouches that meet your needs.
about:
Comfort Foods Co-packing & Processing has operated from Albuquerque, New Mexico for over 30 years. The company began with a goal to provide high-quality, delicious, healthy ingredients and custom blends to customers seeking flexible co-packing solutions.

The 44,000-square-foot facility houses blending and packaging lines that handle both wet and dry products. Capabilities span custom blending, custom packaging, co-packaging, custom formulation, and private label manufacturing. Production runs accommodate volumes from less than half an ounce up to 50-pound bulk packs, with wet options such as salsas, barbecue sauces, jellies, salad dressings, and condiments, and dry options including seasoning blends, soup mixes, bread mixes, dip mixes, and dessert mixes. Packaging formats range from bulk containers to plastic and glass bottles, pouches, packets, portion cups, and cartons.

The company serves food brands and private-label clients across categories such as condiments, sauces, seasoning blends, baking mixes, and snack foods. Customers bring their own formulations, request proprietary development, or select from Comfort Foods' house recipes.

Comfort Foods emphasizes quality assurance through a full-time QC staff and programs that include SQF with Costco addendum certification, HACCP, allergen control, FDA compliance, recall procedures, sample retention, metal detection, GMP adherence, and Kosher certification. Membership in the Contract Manufacturers Association further underscores its focus on industry standards.
